description: Source file defining 3D shape functions (plane, box, sphere, cylinder, torus) for a graphics library, using Lua bindings.

methods.name: plane
methods.description: Creates a plane shape with specified dimensions, rendering faces and edges if fill/stroke are enabled.

methods.name: box
methods.description: Creates a box shape with specified width, height, depth, rendering faces and edges if fill/stroke are enabled.

methods.name: sphere
methods.description: Creates a sphere shape with specified radius and detail, rendering faces and edges if fill/stroke are enabled.

methods.name: cylinder
methods.description: Creates a cylinder shape with specified radius, height, detail, and caps, rendering faces and edges if fill/stroke are enabled.

methods.name: torus
methods.description: Creates a torus shape with specified radius, tube radius, and detail, rendering faces and edges if fill/stroke are enabled.
